items.q: And so he joined the group and was with me--not for long, but several weeks

ctx.x: And so he joined the group and was with me--not for long, but several weeks, and we got very tight and he gave me some arrangements. You see, if you weren't in that big
money, those arrangements cost you. So J.J. said I'm just glad you're doing this work and said see if you can tell somebody about my writing.
